css_file.description: The CSS output file. Required if sourcemap is enabled.

include_paths.description: Optional directory paths to find @imported (S)CSS files. Can be used multiple times.

omit_sourcemap_url.description: Omit source map URL comment from output.

scss_file.description: The SCSS source file to compile.

sourcemap.description: Emit source map. Requires the second argument (output CSS filename).

sourcemap_file.description: Output file for source map. If not specified, defaults to output filename + .map.

sourcemap_root.description: Base path, will be emitted to sourceRoot in source-map as is.

style.description: Coding style of the compiled result: nested, expanded, compact, or compressed.
